headings.usage: Use for all H1, H2, H3 and prominent display text.

body.usage: Use for paragraphs, labels, buttons, and UI elements.

visual_enhancers.textures: Apply a very subtle SVG noise overlay (`opacity-20`) on large colored areas to give a tactile, paper-like feel.

grids_and_layouts.spacing_scale: Use generous spacing. Default section padding should be `py-20` or `py-24`. Card internal padding should be `p-8`.
grids_and_layouts.generator: Two-column split (`grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-8`). Inputs on left (`col-span-5`), live output/score on right (`col-span-7`).

component_rules.buttons: Pill-shaped (`rounded-full`). Primary buttons use Terracotta background with White text. Secondary buttons use outline or soft background. Include a slight `-translate-y-0.5` transform on hover.
component_rules.cards: White background, `rounded-2xl`, subtle warm shadow. Must have a 1px border of `#EBE6E0`. Internal padding `p-8`.
component_rules.inputs_and_forms: Rounded-xl borders, `#EBE6E0` border color, `#F5F2EA` background on focus with `#E06D53` ring.
component_rules.header_nav: Sticky header with crystal glassmorphism (`bg-[#FDFBF7]/80 backdrop-blur-md`). Do NOT use transparent header without blur.
component_rules.listing_score: Use a circular progress ring or a prominent badge with the score. Color-code based on score (Green for 80+, Yellow for 50-79, Red for <50).

motion_and_interactions.hover: All interactive elements must have a hover state. Buttons get slightly darker and lift up.
motion_and_interactions.transitions: Use specific transitions. E.g., `transition-transform duration-200 ease-out, transition-colors duration-200 ease-out`. DO NOT use `transition-all`.
motion_and_interactions.entrance: Staggered fade-in-up for list items and dashboard cards.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure Terracotta `#E06D53` on white has sufficient contrast for large text and buttons. Use Deep Teal `#1F5E5B` if higher contrast is needed for smaller critical text.
accessibility.focus: All focusable elements must have a clear focus ring: `focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#E06D53] focus:ring-offset-2 focus:ring-offset-[#FDFBF7]`.
accessibility.aria: Use aria-labels for icon-only buttons. Add `data-testid` to all interactive elements.

hero_background.description: Textured terracotta surface for subtle background elements or hero image overlays.

maker_1.description: Person crafting white clay pot. Use for before/after examples or features section.

maker_2.description: Woman using laptop in a clean studio. Good for testimonial or 'Solo Etsy Seller' representation.

product_example.description: Crochet toy example product. Perfect for the Listing Generator visual demo.

instructions_to_main_agent: NEVER use generic fonts like Inter or Roboto for headings. Use Lora for headings and DM Sans for body.
Implement the UI with a warm, maker-focused aesthetic. Avoid corporate blue/gray color schemes.
Ensure generous spacing (`p-8`, `gap-8`) to prevent a cluttered, 'cheap' look.
When creating the Listing Generator, use a two-column layout on desktop (inputs left, output right).
Include a 'Listing Score' element that visually highlights the quality of the generated listing.
Use pill-shaped buttons (`rounded-full`) for primary actions, matching the organic feel.
Use Lucide-React icons for UI elements, but keep them minimal and elegant.
DO NOT use `transition: all` in CSS. Use specific transitions like `transition-colors` or `transition-transform`.
Include `data-testid` on all buttons, links, and forms.
Avoid fully transparent headers if content scrolls beneath them. Use a frosted glass effect (`backdrop-blur`).
Do not use generic gray borders; use the warm `#EBE6E0` border color to maintain the cohesive aesthetic.
In Tailwind config, extend the font family: `fontFamily: { sans: ['DM Sans', 'sans-serif'], serif: ['Lora', 'serif'] }`.
Write code in .js / .jsx, since this environment uses JS, not TSX.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: `transition: all`. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add `.App { text-align: center; }` in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Create new components that match the style and conventions of existing components when needed.
Use pure HTML + Tailwind for marketing/landing pages, and Shadcn UI for the dashboard/generator.
